name: Richard Sauerbrun
bio: Richard Sauerbrun has been a PAS member since 2019 and serves on the Board of Directors as treasurer. He practices Electronically Assisted Astronomy (EAA), using telescopes and astronomy cameras—including his Askar 103mm APO refractor—to present views of the night sky at Star Tours events. He also enjoys delivering multi-media astronomy presentations and is always working to expand his observing skills and knowledge of the cosmos.
